history.content:
作为 Claude-Sonnet AI 助手，我可以帮您规划一个简短的国外出差兼旅行行程。

## 三天国外出差兼旅行行程安排

### 第一天 - 抵达与工作
- 上午：抵达目的地，办理入住手续
- 中午：在酒店附近简单用餐，调整时差
- 下午：参加商务会议或工作安排
- 晚上：与商业伙伴共进晚餐，建立关系

### 第二天 - 工作与初步探索
- 上午：继续商务会议或工作
- 中午：工作午餐
- 下午：完成剩余工作事项
- 晚上：参观目的地城市的一处著名景点或特色区域

### 第三天 - 充分利用旅行时间
- 上午：参观当地一处文化或历史景点
- 中午：品尝当地特色美食
- 下午：购买纪念品或参加一项当地特色活动
- 晚上：打包行李，准备次日返程

### 实用建议
- 提前研究目的地的交通方式，考虑酒店与工作地点的距离
- 合理安排工作与旅行时间，确保工作任务优先完成
- 考虑时差因素，给身体适应的时间
- 准备适合商务和休闲两用的衣物
- 随身携带必要的工作设备和文件

history.content_en:
As your Claude-Sonnet AI assistant, I can help you plan a short business trip combined with travel.

## Three-Day Business Trip and Travel Itinerary

### Day 1 - Arrival and Work
- Morning: Arrive at the destination and check in to the hotel
- Noon: Have a simple meal near the hotel and adjust to the time difference
- Afternoon: Attend business meetings or work arrangements
- Evening: Dine with business partners to build relationships

### Day 2 - Work and Initial Exploration
- Morning: Continue with business meetings or work
- Noon: Working lunch
- Afternoon: Complete remaining work tasks
- Evening: Visit a famous landmark or distinctive area in the destination city

### Day 3 - Make the Most of Travel Time
- Morning: Visit a local cultural or historical site
- Noon: Taste local specialty cuisine
- Afternoon: Buy souvenirs or participate in a local activity
- Evening: Pack luggage and prepare for the return trip the next day

### Practical Tips
- Research transportation options at the destination in advance, considering the distance between the hotel and work location
- Arrange work and travel time reasonably to ensure work tasks are prioritized
- Consider the time difference and allow time for your body to adjust
- Prepare clothing suitable for both business and leisure
- Carry necessary work equipment and documents with you

If you can provide a specific destination country or city, I can offer more detailed and targeted suggestions.

history.content: 有没有推荐的饮食安排
history.content_en: Do you have any recommended meal plans?

history.content:
为您准备一份澳大利亚出差旅行期间的饮食建议：

### 餐饮推荐

#### 早餐选择
- 澳式早餐：Flat White咖啡搭配吐司、鳄梨酱(Avocado Toast)
- 酒店自助早餐，可选择新鲜水果、谷物和蛋类

#### 午餐推荐
- 当地三明治或汉堡
- 海鲜沙拉
- 澳大利亚特色肉饼(Meat Pie)
- 轻食餐厅或快餐店

#### 晚餐选择
1. 海鲜餐厅
   - 品尝澳大利亚新鲜海鲜
   - 悉尼和墨尔本的海鲜餐厅尤其推荐

2. 烧烤餐厅(BBQ)
   - 品尝澳式烧烤牛排
   - 体验当地特色烹饪文化

3. 亚洲风味餐厅
   - 澳大利亚多元文化，亚洲餐厅选择丰富
   - 适合不太习惯西式口味的旅客

#### 小吃和饮品
- Tim Tam饼干
- Vegemite吐司涂抹酱
- 澳大利亚精品咖啡
- 当地精酿啤酒

### 饮食注意事项
- 携带个人特殊饮食需求的说明卡片
- 提前了解餐厅的营业时间
- 准备现金和信用卡
- 注意食物过敏原
- 适度饮酒

### 推荐用餐App
- Zomato
- Uber Eats
- Google Maps餐厅评价

希望这个建议对您的澳大利亚之行有帮助！祝您旅途愉快。
history.content_en:
Here are some dietary suggestions for your business trip to Australia:

### Dining Recommendations

#### Breakfast Options
- Australian Breakfast: Flat White coffee paired with toast and Avocado Toast
- Hotel buffet breakfast, with options for fresh fruits, cereals, and eggs

#### Lunch Recommendations
- Local sandwiches or burgers
- Seafood salad
- Australian specialty Meat Pie
- Casual dining or fast food restaurants

#### Dinner Choices
1. Seafood Restaurant
   - Enjoy fresh Australian seafood
   - Seafood restaurants in Sydney and Melbourne are especially recommended

2. BBQ Restaurant
   - Try Australian-style grilled steak
   - Experience the local culinary culture

3. Asian Cuisine Restaurant
   - Australia’s multiculturalism offers a wide variety of Asian restaurants
   - Suitable for travelers who may not be accustomed to Western flavors

#### Snacks and Beverages
- Tim Tam biscuits
- Vegemite spread on toast
- Australian specialty coffee
- Local craft beer

### Dietary Considerations
- Carry a card explaining any personal dietary needs
- Check restaurant opening hours in advance
- Prepare cash and credit cards
- Be aware of food allergens
- Drink alcohol in moderation

### Recommended Dining Apps
- Zomato
- Uber Eats
- Google Maps restaurant reviews

I hope these suggestions are helpful for your trip to Australia! Have a great journey.
